svg.title: Workflow: Customer-experience agent
svg.desc: Solution workflow (hybrid) for Customer-experience agent: 1 trigger: Shopper sends a message on messaging or email → conversation opened with unified identity and cross-channel memory; 2 agent: Understands the request in natural language and picks a skill → skill call; 3 skill: Reads live order, tracking, refund or catalogue data from the source systems → verified facts; 4 decision: Is the request an action (return, exchange, cancel)? yes → step 5 / no → step 8; 5 skill: Checks per-item eligibility against window and policy → verdict; 6 decision: Eligible? yes → step 7 / no → step 9; 7 skill: Files the return/exchange or cancels the unshipped order and triggers the refund → record in order and returns systems; 8 agent: Replies with status, answer or product results → resolved conversation (deflected); 9 human: Receives handover with sentiment and severity classification, works the chat or ticket with SLA and CSAT → human resolution; 10 outcome: Self-served conversation or escalated case with full context → deflection and zero broken journeys
